verdict.rationale: Fenwick's public Startup Resource Center offers articles, checklists, presentations and "other tools," plus form-gated overviews such as "Incorporation Stage Issues and Seed Financings Overview" and "Top 10 Legal Issues." These are educational guides, not fillable startup documents. Fenwick Labs mentions automated incorporation-document generation and term-sheet generation, but frames them as services for clients (e.g., "for M&A clients"), not free public tools. Missing for 10: evidence of free downloadable incorporation, SAFE, term-sheet or NDA templates; evidence that any document generator is open to non-clients; hands-on or independent corroboration.
